_readme: Optional. Everything here is OPTIONAL — the hub works with this file empty.
Keys are game slugs (see data/games.json for the slug scan.mjs gave each game).
Anything you put here WINS over what was scraped from the game's HTML.
Any field you add that has values somewhere in the library automatically grows
its own filter rail on the wall. Add nothing and no rails appear. Example:

a-perfectly-normal-audit.description: As overwhelmed laundromat owner Evelyn, survive an IRS audit that splinters into other universes, borrowing skills from lives you never lived to save the laundromat.
a-perfectly-normal-audit.controls: WASD to move, E to talk, R to borrow a life, J to strike, Space to dodge

adventureforge-7.description: Browse an interactive flowchart of the AdventureForge 7 campaign: 11 quest lines, 39 stages and 36 endings, with each action and the story flags it needs.
adventureforge-7.controls: Drag to pan, scroll or +/− to zoom, click an action for details

aetherfall.description: Explore a windswept ridge, restart the Gale Mill, claim the Wind Core from Zephyr Grotto and use its charged wind shot to defeat the Stone Gale.
aetherfall.controls: WASD or arrows to move, Space to attack (hold to charge), Shift to dash, E to interact

after-hours.description: Build a career as an independent companion host in a walkable 3D city, taking café, gallery and jazz-club bookings while balancing money, safety and rest. Non-explicit.
after-hours.controls: WASD to move, E to interact, click a place to walk there

afterglow.description: Run a companion dating business in a 3D harbor city, meeting clients for coffee, gallery and dinner dates while managing your schedule, brand, team and safety. Non-explicit.
afterglow.controls: WASD to move, E to interact, right-drag to orbit, scroll to zoom

afterlight.description: Pilot a lone ship through waves of enemy fighters and bosses, collecting shield, speed and multi-shot power-ups, then save your run to the local score board.
afterlight.controls: WASD or arrows to move, Space to fire, Shift to dodge, F to toggle auto-fire

angel-of-death.description: Work the guns of an AC-130 gunship at night, using a thermal camera to clear roadblocks for a rescue convoy without hitting friendly vehicles or a protected clinic.
angel-of-death.controls: Mouse to aim, hold click to fire, 1–3 to switch guns, V for thermal mode, C to adjust the orbit

apex-pocket-99.description: Race a late-90s sports car around a night harbor expressway in a six-car club race, or run time trials to beat your best lap.
apex-pocket-99.controls: W/S to accelerate and brake, A/D to steer, Space for handbrake, C to change camera

ashfall.description: Pick a Warden, Ranger or Engineer and push one of three fronts: capture shield relays, break the fortress gates and destroy the reactor, with AI allies or LAN friends.
ashfall.controls: WASD to move, right-click to travel, Q/E/R for skills, Space to dash

assault-suits.description: Pilot a combat mech suit across an orbital carrier's cargo deck, blocking fire with your shield, upgrading your cannon and shutting down the reactor.
assault-suits.controls: WASD to move, mouse to aim and fire, Space to jump and jet, right-click to shield

assault-suits-3d.description: Pilot a mech suit through a 3D side-view hangar, breaching a bulkhead, crossing broken decks, destroying the Warden and escaping before the reactor fails.
assault-suits-3d.controls: A/D to move, W/S to aim, J to fire, Space to jump and hover, L to shield

bannerbound.description: Lead a small company through four chapters of turn-based grid battles, training fighters, archers, casters and healers to restore a kingdom that has lost its memory.
bannerbound.controls: Arrows to pick a tile, Enter to confirm, 1–4 for move, attack, skills and items, Q/E to rotate

bannerbound-hollow-bell.description: Guide four friends through three tactical grid battles to keep the royal guard from waking an army with an abbey bell, switching between six jobs and learning arts at camp.
bannerbound-hollow-bell.controls: Arrows to move the cursor, Enter to confirm, 1–5 for commands, Q/E to rotate

bark-and-brush.description: Play a dog with a magic brush: circle bare trees to bloom, slash ink masks and zigzag bridges back together to wake three groves and bring spring back to the vale.
bark-and-brush.controls: WASD to move, Space to jump, click to strike, F then draw with the mouse to paint

baybreak-cab-rush.description: Drive a cab through a procedurally generated bay city, picking up and dropping off three riders before the shift clock runs out, with tips for drifts and near-misses.
baybreak-cab-rush.controls: W/S to throttle and brake, A/D to steer, Space to drift

beachhead.description: Storm a beach landing in a combat exosuit, die, and wake to try again, using what you remember to find Rita and change your route across a block-built battlefield.
beachhead.controls: WASD to move, mouse to aim and fire, Shift to sprint, Space to jump, E to interact

behind-glass.description: Play Howard in his jewelry store and Julia at the casino as a three-part basketball bet plays out, and decide whether to let the men at the door in.
behind-glass.controls: WASD to move, mouse to look, E to interact, P for the phone, B for the bet slip

behind-glass-one-last-bet.description: Guide Howard around a brick-built diorama of his jewelry store: call Julia, hold the security door and watch the game as a $155,000 three-way parlay plays out.
behind-glass-one-last-bet.controls: WASD to move, E to interact, click to walk, drag to orbit

big-money-big-prizes-tv.description: Fight through a twin-stick game-show arena, blasting enemy waves and bosses while grabbing cash and prizes, alone or in online co-op for up to four players.
big-money-big-prizes-tv.controls: WASD to move, arrow keys or mouse to aim and fire, Space for your perk

birdie-buddies.description: Play the three-hole Clover Cup golf course with a classic three-tap swing, choosing clubs, spin and power shots to clear ponds, sand and trees.
birdie-buddies.controls: Space to start the swing, set power, then stop on the white line; up/down arrows to change club

bitcrash.description: Run and jump through a storm-battered turbine works as a small robot, spending scrap on upgrades at the service bay before shutting down the Gale Warden.
bitcrash.controls: A/D or arrows to move, Space to jump, J to fire, E to use

block-court.description: Play 3-on-3 arcade basketball to 21 with turbo dunks, steals and timed shots, or practice freely in Shootaround mode.
block-court.controls: WASD to move, hold Space and release to shoot, E to pass, F to steal, Shift for turbo

block-party-beasts.description: Play a giant monster climbing and punching through buildings, snacking to heal and swatting tanks, to flatten three city blocks before the clock runs out.
block-party-beasts.controls: Arrows or WASD to move and climb, J to punch, Space to jump, K to grab food, L to roar

bramblebound.description: Guide a young knight and a healing friend through a village adventure with turn-based battles, keeping a promise to bring the missing children home.
bramblebound.controls: WASD to move, E or Space to talk, 1–4 for battle commands

bramblebound-crown-of-the-skybell.description: Leave Briarwick, clear the Sunroad of Spriggles in real-time combat, and defeat the Bellback Brute to ring the old Skybell again.
bramblebound-crown-of-the-skybell.controls: WASD to move, mouse to look, Space to strike, Q for whirlwind, E to mend, Shift to dodge

brass-barnacle.description: Run and gun along a harbor pier, freeing captured dock crew, taking over an armored loader and bringing down a walking dredger.
brass-barnacle.controls: A/D to move, Space to jump, J to fire, L to throw grenades, E to enter the loader

brass-hopper.description: Run and gun through a harbor overrun by crabs with a rivet gun, grenades and a wrench, freeing the crew and breaking the blockade.
brass-hopper.controls: Arrows to move and aim, Z to fire, X to jump, C for grenades

break-point.description: Play 15-red snooker with a friend on one device, passing the controls each turn, or learn the rules in eight practice lessons.
break-point.controls: Left/right arrows to aim, hold Space and release to shoot, V to change view

brick-league.description: Play a three-minute five-a-side football match against the CPU as Ember FC or Tide United, passing, sliding in for tackles and charging up shots.
brick-league.controls: WASD to move, hold Space to shoot, E to pass, J to tackle, Shift to sprint

brickfall.name: BRICKFALL
brickfall.description: Fight through a block-built foundry in first person, breaking relay locks, grabbing and throwing blocks with a gravity tool, and escaping with the core. Includes a physics lab.
brickfall.controls: WASD to move, mouse to aim and fire, right-click to grab with the Gravlink, E to use

brickhawk.description: Fly an attack helicopter over a neon delta, knocking out radar sites, winching three engineers back to the carrier and stopping a missile launcher before time runs out.
brickhawk.controls: WASD to fly, Space to fire, R for rockets, F for missiles, E to winch, Q for flares

bright-minds.description: Build an AI company from 1948 into the far future, adding rooms, funding research and learning the idea behind each breakthrough before you scale it.
bright-minds.controls: Drag to rotate, scroll to zoom, Space to pause, B to build, R for research

cavern-crew-ii.description: Explore a smugglers' cave as a kid crew, opening three seals, upgrading your sling and jacket with scrap, and breaking through the Smuggler Gate to rescue Mara.
cavern-crew-ii.controls: WASD to move, Space to fire the sling, E to use, Shift to dash

city-duty.description: Drive a city bus on a fictional Helsinki route, opening the doors at six stops, helping passengers board and watching the traffic and signals.
city-duty.controls: W/S to accelerate and brake, A/D to steer, F and G for the doors, Space for emergency brake

cloudbreak-cadets.description: Fly over Gull Coast with your wingmate Pip, rolling to deflect red fire, flying through repair rings, and breaking a storm carrier's engines and core.
cloudbreak-cadets.controls: WASD or arrows to fly, Space to fire, Q/E to roll, B for bombs

clover-kart-64.description: Race seven rivals over three laps of Clover Castle Circuit, holding drifts for mini-turbos and grabbing items to win the Clover Cup.
clover-kart-64.controls: WASD to drive, Shift to drift, Space to use items

cobbleheart-iv.description: Lead four odd heroes around a low-poly town and into turn-based battles, setting party tactics, to win the Lantern Tourney and its burning crown.
cobbleheart-iv.controls: WASD to move, Space or A to talk, menu commands in battle

comet-cub.description: Fly a short canyon run through the Amber Pass, rolling to block red shots and repairing at green rings, then destroy the gate keeper's pods and core.
comet-cub.controls: WASD or arrows to steer, Space to fire, Q/E to roll, B for bombs

comet-jackals.description: Break through a relay moon's defenses, shake a bandit off your wingmate's tail, thread three signal arches for twin blasters and disable the enemy gate barge.
comet-jackals.controls: WASD or arrows to steer, Space to fire, B for bombs, Shift to boost, Q/E to bank

company-hours.description: Balance a companionship career and a personal life in a small 3D town, choosing date conversation topics, growing your reputation, and paying rent and permits. Non-explicit.
company-hours.controls: Click to walk or WASD to move, Q/E to rotate, drag to pan

complete-dark.description: As Agent 07, infiltrate Asterion Tower at night: disable the rooftop relay, copy the Nightfall archive and get back to the roof for extraction.
complete-dark.controls: WASD to move, mouse to aim, click or Space to fire, E to use, hold Q to scan

crown-and-clay.description: Grow an empire from a single settler: found cities, research new technologies, build farms, mines and wonders, and deal with rival realms and raiders.
crown-and-clay.controls: Enter to end turn, Space for next unit, F to found or fortify, WASD to pan, Q/E to rotate

crown-and-clay-one-more-turn.description: Build a small empire turn by turn and win one of three ways: peace through trade pacts, culture by finishing the Sunspire, or capturing both rival capitals.
crown-and-clay-one-more-turn.controls: Drag to pan, scroll to zoom, Space to end turn, N for next unit

crown-and-comet.description: Lead three travelers across Sunmeadow and into the gloomy Rootvault to recover the stolen Dawn Bell, fighting turn-based battles along the way.
crown-and-comet.controls: WASD to move, E or Space to interact, menu commands in battle

crown-of-emberfall.description: As a lone young warden, cross the old bridge to Cinderhollow, fight turn-based battles and defeat the Ashback Drake to bring the Dawn Shard back to King Rowan.
crown-of-emberfall.controls: WASD or arrows to move, Space or Enter to act

crownward.description: Guide three royal heirs along a monster-filled road to the ruined Skywatch, fighting turn-based battles to recover the Starstone and relight the beacon.
crownward.controls: WASD to move, E or Space to act, Shift to run

cul-de-sac-kings.description: Roam a sunset West Coast neighborhood on foot or by car, hunt six hidden tapes, lose the police and bring the block's speakers back to Sunset Park.
cul-de-sac-kings.controls: WASD to move or drive, F to enter cars, mouse to aim, click to fire or punch

cyberdyne-lockdown.name: Cyberdyne Lockdown
cyberdyne-lockdown.description: Hold the second floor of a research building against two waves of police, shredding cars and cover with a minigun and grenades, then escape by elevator.
cyberdyne-lockdown.controls: WASD to move, mouse to aim, click to fire, 1–4 to switch weapons, G/H for grenades

dare-devil-driver.description: Drive one clean lap of a stunt circuit through a loop, a leap and a twist against the clock, or design your own courses in the track editor.
dare-devil-driver.controls: Arrows or WASD to accelerate, brake and steer, C to change camera, R to recover

datapunk-2078.description: Work through Mercy Street in first person, scanning guards and devices, then use quickhacks, quiet takedowns or open gunfire to breach a data relay.
datapunk-2078.controls: WASD to move, mouse to look and fire, hold Tab to scan, F to upload quickhacks

days-of-daytona-usa.description: Start 40th on a sunny seaside circuit and race three laps, beating five named rivals in close duels with drafts, dekes and bump-and-run passes.
days-of-daytona-usa.controls: Arrows or WASD to drive, Space to slide, Q/E to shift gears, C to change view

destruction-company.description: Clear a path through a small town before a runaway reactor carrier arrives, switching between a bulldozer, a drift truck and a jumping stomp machine.
destruction-company.controls: WASD to drive, Space to ram, drift or stomp, 1–3 to switch vehicles, E to use

diamond-club.description: Play 3, 6 or 9 innings of low-poly baseball against the CPU: bat, pitch, field and run the bases, or sit back and watch a full game.
diamond-club.controls: Space to swing or pitch, 1–3 to pick a pitch, arrows to move fielders

digital-cop.description: Ride the rails through a locked-down harbor, shooting armed suspects before their threat rings close while sparing dock workers, then take down the Foreman.
digital-cop.controls: Point and click to shoot, R or right-click to reload

down.description: Fly a six-axis ship through a silent moon mine, find the blue and red access keys, rescue missing crew, destroy the reactor and escape before it blows.
down.controls: WASD to thrust and strafe, mouse to aim, Space/Ctrl to rise and fall, click to fire, right-click for missiles

dream-shift.description: Lead a dream heist across shifting gravity: fend off attackers, tether your sleeping team and trigger the kick before the van hits the water in three minutes.
dream-shift.controls: WASD to move, Space to strike, Shift to block, E to use

dreambound.description: Fetch the festival crown from a mountain pass, fall through a sky-rift into a mirror world, and win turn-based party battles to save the Starbell Festival.
dreambound.controls: WASD to move, E or Space to talk, Shift to dash, click commands in battle

dust-devil-rally.description: Slide a 4WD hatch round a two-lap mountain stage of gravel, tarmac and timber bridges against seven drivers, reaching checkpoints before the clock runs out.
dust-devil-rally.controls: WASD or arrows to drive, Space to slide, R to reset, C to change camera

dust-signal.description: Wake at a frontline outpost, report for duty, then fly a recon drone to confirm and disable a relay and two armored vehicles so an evacuation convoy can get through.
dust-signal.controls: WASD to move or fly, mouse to look, Space/Ctrl to climb and descend, hold E to scan, click to fire

dustshot.description: Gun your way north through a western town, break crates to find a hidden WANTED poster, buy upgrades from the gunsmith, then face Marshal Vex at the stockade.
dustshot.controls: WASD to move, mouse to aim, click or Space to fire, E to trade

e-zero.description: Start 100th of 100 hover racers and fight to the front over three laps of a neon harbor track, using hyper boost and pink strips to recharge your power.
e-zero.controls: Arrows or A/D to steer, hold Space to boost, Down to brake

earthquake.description: Fight through an old-school shooter level with shotgun, nailgun and rockets, find the brass key, power the reactor, beat the Gate Warden and hunt two secrets.
earthquake.controls: WASD to move, mouse to aim, click to fire, Space to jump, E to use

elite.description: Trade cargo and fight pirates in a wireframe Cobra on the Lave to Leesti run, then match a rotating station's spin to dock by hand or with the docking computer.
elite.controls: WASD to steer, R/F for speed, Space to fire, H to hyperspace, C to auto-dock

ember.description: A character animation test: watch one run cycle on a black stage, compare its 16 source poses with 60 smoothed frames, and step through frames or move the runner.
ember.controls: A/D or arrows to turn and run, Space to pause, H to hide controls

everything-is-deductible.description: Sit through a tax audit to save the family laundromat, then slip into other versions of your life, fend off threats and find what matters in a short multiverse story.
everything-is-deductible.controls: WASD to move, mouse to look, E to interact, F to swing, Space to dodge

fare-play.description: Pick up fares around the hilly streets of Sunset Bay and rush them to their stops, earning tips for drifts, near misses and ramp jumps, or cruise freely with no clock.
fare-play.controls: WASD to drive, Space to drift, Shift to boost, R to recover

first-fantasy-6.description: Lead a party into a frozen northern mine, open the pressure valves and find the source of a strange signal, with 16-bit style time-bar battles, magic and relics.
first-fantasy-6.controls: Arrows to move, Z or Enter to confirm, X to cancel, Esc for the menu

first-fantasy-7.description: Join a rebel cell on a night raid into Reactor 07: slip past patrols, rescue Mara, restore bridge power and plant the charge, with active-time battles on the way.
first-fantasy-7.controls: WASD to move, E to interact, arrows and Enter in battle, Esc for the menu

flip-the-beet.description: Watch Master Beet perform a rhythm, then repeat it note for note in the Root Dojo, building combos and adding extra beats on Chill, Original or Remix difficulty.
flip-the-beet.controls: A, S, D, F to kick, chop, turn and pose in time

frostfire.description: A WebGPU scene prototype for a winter text adventure: four illustrated places with live snow, embers and weather, where you pick actions and move between areas.
frostfire.controls: Keys 1–3 to choose actions, arrows to preview scenes, H to hide the interface

frostfire-concept.description: A slide presentation for the Frostfire text-adventure concept, with live WebGPU winter scenes, an effects lab, a room map and a sample turn-based wolf encounter.
frostfire-concept.controls: Arrows to move between slides, P to pause motion

galaxy-harrier.description: Fly low over the Prism Fields in an 80s-style into-the-screen shooter, dodging stone columns and enemy fire before taking on a giant sky serpent.
galaxy-harrier.controls: WASD or arrows to move, hold Space to fire, Shift for a pulse bomb

glasshouse.description: Locked in a jewelry store with $155,000 and debt collectors at the door, choose whether to pay up or let a basketball parlay ride in this short first-person thriller.
glasshouse.controls: WASD to move, mouse to look, E to interact

gloomkeep.description: Explore a rain-soaked keep in an 8-bit point-and-click adventure, solving object puzzles and managing your torchlight to restore the voice of the Hollow Bell.
gloomkeep.controls: Click to look and use objects, 1–8 for commands, M for the map, J for the journal

good-company.description: Run your own paid companionship business in a small isometric town: screen clients, keep a calendar, manage money and wellbeing, and stay independent or join an agency.
good-company.controls: Click to walk, WASD to move, Q/E to rotate, F to interact

good-company-a-life-you-make.description: A cozy career sim about a companionship business: walk a low-poly seaside town, screen and meet clients, set rates and boundaries, and look after your energy and stress.
good-company-a-life-you-make.controls: WASD or arrows to move, E to interact, J for the journal, M for places

gunhand.description: Fly a one-armed fighter through a neon city blockade, tearing guns off enemy ships to use as your own, and break the Debt Collector's gun mounts to expose its core.
gunhand.controls: WASD to move, Space to fire, K to fire the gunpod, Q to flip the arm, E for EMP

hearth-and-home.description: Guide a couple through a lifetime on Willow Lane: manage household cash, make big life choices, raise a family and grow old together in a low-poly isometric home.

hellshift.description: Clock in at a demon-infested waste facility, find the red access key, switch on the reactor and take down the Foreman in a retro shooter level with three weapons.
hellshift.controls: WASD to move, mouse or arrows to turn, click or Space to fire, E to use

helsinki-driver.description: Drive a city bus on a training route through central Helsinki: power up, open the front and middle doors, kneel the bus and deploy the ramp at stops, in dry or wet weather.
helsinki-driver.controls: WASD or arrows to drive, E for power, F/G for the doors, K to kneel, R for the ramp

holdfast.description: Build a defender from weapons, perks and support strikes, then protect a relay against endless waves across a large field, grabbing supplies from outer posts.
holdfast.controls: WASD to move, mouse to aim and fire, Space to dash, Q to swap weapons, R to reload

hollow-dues.description: Descend into the hollow beneath a silent belfry, fighting with blades that wear down, paying the mender in life, and taking back the bell's stolen tongue.
hollow-dues.controls: WASD to move, mouse to look, click to strike, right-click to guard, F to drink a flask

honk-and-hustle.description: Drive a Bay City cab on a 90-second shift, stopping in colored rings to collect riders and racing them to their stops, with each pickup adding five seconds.
honk-and-hustle.controls: WASD or arrows to drive, Space to drift, Shift for a burst, H for the horn; optional mouse driving

hookshift.description: Swing through a jungle fortress on a grappling cable with no jump button, clearing patrols and turrets on high or low routes to shut down Relay Spire 7's transmitter.
hookshift.controls: A/D to move and swing, W/S to reel, Space to grapple, F to fire, E to interact

hot-rotor.description: Fly an attack helicopter to knock out a radar station, winch three engineers to safety and destroy a missile carrier before launch, watching your fuel and armor.
hot-rotor.controls: WASD to fly, mouse to aim, click or Space to fire, hold E to winch, F for flares

hot-treads.description: Pick a tank, cross the river, blast open the enemy base and bring their flag home, freeing captured crew from cages on the way.
hot-treads.controls: WASD to drive, mouse to aim and fire, Space to fire with auto-aim, Q for mines, E for smoke

hotshift-92.description: Race 19 rivals over three laps of a Nevada desert circuit at sunset, saving nitro for the straights and timing a fuel stop to finish in the top five.
hotshift-92.controls: Arrows or WASD to drive, Space for nitro, E to queue a pit stop

hover-and-out.description: Fly a small rescue helicopter into the desert, shoot open compound gates and ferry all 24 people home eight at a time while dodging tanks and enemy aircraft.
hover-and-out.controls: WASD or arrows to fly, Space to fire, X to drop bombs, Q to turn

hover-duty.description: Patrol a night city from a gunship cockpit: scan a suspect cargo truck, shoot down gunships, escort an arrest van and land back on the pad.
hover-duty.controls: Mouse to steer and aim, W/S for thrust, A/D to slide, Q/E for altitude, click to fire

hudsons-little-kitchen.description: A calm 3D kitchen for little ones: tap the fridge, cups, fruit and more to hear their names and simple sentences, with a PIN-locked corner for grown-ups.
hudsons-little-kitchen.controls: Tap an object to hear its name, swipe to look around

hudsons-word-world.description: A picture-and-sound word app to share with a toddler: browse over 3,000 word cards by topic and play find-it, sound and bubble-counting games, with grown-up settings.
hudsons-word-world.controls: Tap pictures to hear their words

hush-hour.description: Take a sniper perch over a harbor city at rush hour: clear rooftop gunmen, protect two hostages, then shoot the engine pods off an escaping gunship.
hush-hour.controls: Mouse to aim, click to fire, Shift to steady, scroll to zoom, C for cover

hush-hour-crosswind.description: A sniper mission built on real bullet flight: allow for wind and drop across four phases, from a rooftop sweep to the Kingpin, with three rifles and four round types.
hush-hour-crosswind.controls: Mouse to aim, click to fire, Space for fine aim, R to reload, Z to set zero

intelligence-tycoon.description: Run an AI research institute from Dartmouth in 1956 onward: hire researchers, fund projects and compete with rival labs while learning real milestones in the field.
intelligence-tycoon.controls: Drag to orbit, scroll to zoom, Space to play or pause, N to advance a quarter

iron-veil.description: Pick one of three heroes and hold an outpost with two AI squadmates through 20 waves of machines, capturing relays, choosing upgrades and fighting heavy bosses.
iron-veil.controls: WASD to move, mouse to aim and fire, Q/E/R for skills, Space to dash

ironhold.description: Build extractors, generators, walls and gun towers, train troop squads and keep the command core alive through 12 waves on four fronts, solo or with friends.
ironhold.controls: WASD to move the camera, Q/E to rotate, scroll to zoom, click to build, drag to select troops

jackpot-riot-tv.description: Survive a violent TV game show as a twin-stick shooter: clear studio waves, grab cash and prizes, open the prize vault and beat the House to win a gold toaster.
jackpot-riot-tv.controls: WASD to move, mouse or arrows to shoot, Space to dash, E for a smart bomb

keto-courier.description: Carry glucose, fatty acids and ketones between the liver, brain and muscles in a small 3D delivery game that walks you into ketosis and back out again.
keto-courier.controls: WASD or drag to move, Space to dash

killer8.description: Move through a strange hotel as eight switchable assassins, scanning for hidden laughing enemies, breaking blood seals and heading for a vacant floor to kill the Tenant.
killer8.controls: Hold W to run the path, S to turn, Q or right mouse to aim, click to fire, E to scan, Tab to switch identity

knuckle-pop.description: Box your way through three oversized boardwalk fighters, reading each one's tells, dodging and countering to win the Boardwalk Belt.
knuckle-pop.controls: J/K to punch, hold Up to punch high, Left/Right to dodge, Down to duck, Space for a power punch

lantern-road.description: Guide Ari up a 3D country road to relight the hill beacon, opening chests and fighting road creatures in turn-based battles before facing the Bellhorn Warden.
lantern-road.controls: WASD or arrows to move, Space or E to talk and interact; battles use on-screen commands

little-lives.description: Settle Mia Bloom into a new isometric home: cook, make friends, finish paid gigs and buy and build furniture, walls and floors before hosting a housewarming.
little-lives.controls: Click objects and the floor to act; Space to pause, 1–3 to change speed

little-lot.description: Help Mara Bloom settle into a block-built little house: keep her needs up, befriend neighbor June, decorate, and finish four small steps before a housewarming party.
little-lot.controls: Click objects to use them, drag to move the view; Space to pause, 1–3 to change speed

little-orbit.description: Walk a tiny planet delivering four warm coffees from the café to neighbors, with side trips to a sky library, an orchard, a painted studio and a small cinema.
little-orbit.controls: WASD to move, Space to jump, E to use; R to return to the café

little-world.description: A toddler play space for singing nursery songs like Twinkle, Twinkle, meeting the ABCs and counting, with big tap targets and a locked grown-up area.
little-world.controls: Tap or click to choose songs, letters and numbers

mamba-bay.description: Pilot an armed speedboat through three missions: race up Copper Canyon, rescue five crew in Castaway Cove, then sink the giant crab King Claw.
mamba-bay.controls: WASD or arrows to drive, Space to fire, Shift to boost, X for missiles

mango-mischief.description: Jump and spin through four 3D jungle levels, from the coast to an old temple, collecting mangoes and sun shards on the way to the Sunstone.
mango-mischief.controls: WASD to move, Space to jump, J to spin

mercenary-strike.description: Fly a voxel helicopter over a generated island region, collecting supplies and returning to base while paying the bills and growing a small mercenary company.
mercenary-strike.controls: WASD to fly, mouse to aim, click to fire, R for rockets, Space to take off and land

mercenary-strike-first-lift.description: Fly a low-poly helicopter around an island, recovering supply crates past gun positions and armed vehicles, and land them back at camp to build your first base.

tailblazer.controls: WASD to steer, hold Space to fire, Q/E to roll, Shift to boost

teaken.description: Fight through the Iron Leaf Tournament with three martial artists in a 3D arcade fighter, face a friend in local versus, or learn combos in practice mode.
teaken.controls: A/D to move, U/I to punch, J/K to kick, H to throw

the-between.description: Follow a missing brother's signal from a real apartment into a pixel-art world, then turn stones to restore the light in the Signal Garden in this story prologue.
the-between.controls: WASD or arrows to move, Enter or Space to continue

the-fall-protocol.description: Protect four sleeping teammates in a shifting dream hotel, fighting projections in first person, bracing as walls become floors and building a kick without gravity.
the-fall-protocol.controls: WASD to move, mouse to look, F or left click to strike, right click to brace, E to use

the-legend-of-the-sword.description: Race three rival sailboats around Ember Isle, passing 16 gold gates, hopping logs, cutting crates with your sword and saving wind bursts for the final stretch.
the-legend-of-the-sword.inspiredBy: The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker
the-legend-of-the-sword.controls: A/D to steer, Shift for wind burst, Space to hop, X to use your sword

the-other-side.description: Step through your screen into a pixel-art overworld, talking to travellers, finding three memories and waking waystones. The entrances to future games are not built yet.
the-other-side.controls: WASD or arrows to move, Shift to run, E or Space to use, M for map

tidewhistle.description: Sail a little boat to Brinebell Key, calling the wind to fill your sail, then fight through the bell garden on foot to wake three chimes and find the Bellseed.
tidewhistle.inspiredBy: The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker
tidewhistle.controls: W to sail, A/D to steer, Q to call the wind, J to slash, Space to roll or hop

tlozoot.description: Explore a sleeping forest and its temple in third person, fighting with sword and seed sling, locking on to foes, playing a flute and restoring three ward flames.
tlozoot.inspiredBy: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
tlozoot.controls: WASD to move, J to swing the sword, K to fire seeds, Z to lock on, Space to roll

tread-lightly.description: Drive a small tank into an enemy base, capture the red flag and bring it home, rescuing prisoners, laying mines and stopping at base to repair and refuel.
tread-lightly.controls: WASD to drive, mouse to aim, click or Space to fire, Q to drop a mine

tread-riot.description: Pick one of three tanks and smash through a Bay City blockade, destroying radio relays, taking down the Iron Bull heavy tank and escaping across the bridge.
tread-riot.controls: WASD to drive, mouse to aim, click to fire, Q for rockets, E for shockwave, Shift to boost

try-hard.description: Play fast seven-a-side arcade rugby against the computer, passing, sidestepping and tackling to score tries, winning rucks and timing your conversion kicks.
try-hard.controls: WASD to move, Shift to sprint, J to pass, K to kick, Space to tackle

tumblecrown.description: Help Pip recover the Mossglass crystal for Sunmeadow's festival bell, crossing clover hills into a grotto and fighting turn-based battles with herbs and Gale Cut.
tumblecrown.controls: WASD to move, drag the mouse to turn, E to interact, Shift to dash

turing-to-dyson.description: Run an AI research lab from the 1950s to a far-future Dyson swarm, placing facilities, curating data, training and auditing models, and weighing profit against public trust.
turing-to-dyson.controls: Click to place facilities and run the lab panels

turnip-knights.description: Lead four small heroes with chosen jobs down through a crystal cave, exploring its floors and fighting turn-based party battles to reach the Hollow Crystal.
turnip-knights.controls: WASD or arrows to move, Enter to interact, Shift to run, I for the bag

undertow.description: Descend seven flooded pixel-art dungeon floors in real-time combat, using water pulses and conductive arc strikes, collecting gear and beating seven guardians.
undertow.controls: WASD to move, mouse to aim, click to attack, Space to dash, Q for water pulse, F for arc strike

undertow-sound-review.description: A listening page for Undertow's sound design, comparing the old and new mix and sampling quiet exploration and combat audio from each of its seven floors.

unstable-eastern-block-region-strike.description: Fly an attack helicopter through a fictional Eastern Bloc exclusion zone, knocking out radar, winching three engineers to safety and destroying mobile launchers.
unstable-eastern-block-region-strike.controls: WASD to fly, mouse to aim, left click to fire, 1–3 to switch weapons, hold E to winch

vector-vulpine.description: Fly a fighter down an auto-scrolling sky corridor over Aeris City, shooting raiders, flying through gates to repair your shield and breaking the Dread Kite carrier.
vector-vulpine.controls: WASD or mouse to steer, Space or click to fire, Q/E to barrel roll, Shift to boost

verdant-frontier.description: Survey a large procedural low-poly wilderness in first person, recording plants, wildlife, water and terrain in a field journal and marking sites with beacons.
verdant-frontier.controls: WASD to move, mouse to look, Q for survey pulse, hold E to record, B to place a beacon

void-explorer.description: Pilot a ship through a procedural universe, flying between stars, descending through atmospheres to land, and stepping out to walk on the surface.
void-explorer.controls: Drag to steer, W/S for thrust, Shift to boost, X to brake, L to land

voxel-guard.description: Defend the voxel valley of Mossvale through 20 waves, placing and upgrading 12 kinds of tower and guiding one of three heroes against enemies up to the Moss Titan.
voxel-guard.controls: Click to place and upgrade towers, right-click to move your hero, Space to start a wave

voxelcraft-engine-lab.name: VoxelCraft Engine Lab
voxelcraft-engine-lab.description: A voxel sandbox test build: walk a generated block world, break and place blocks, craft planks and a workbench, and spawn physics crates to test the Rapier engine.
voxelcraft-engine-lab.controls: WASD to move, mouse to look, left click to break, right click to place, 1–9 to pick a block

waves-of-thunder-64.description: Race jet skis over rolling swells in Sunbreak Bay, passing each buoy on the marked side over three laps against three rivals, or ride a time trial or free ride.
waves-of-thunder-64.controls: WASD or arrows to ride, Space to jump, C to change camera

wildlands.description: An open-world terrain test: walk or fly over a large low-poly world of forests, mountains, rivers and plains, with a day-night cycle and a map to travel by.
wildlands.controls: WASD to move, mouse to look, F to switch walking and flight, M for map

wildlands-framework-01.description: A first procedural world build for developers: walk, swim or fly past lakes, pine forests, snow peaks and red canyons, and jump between regions from the settings.
wildlands-framework-01.controls: WASD to move, mouse to look, Shift to go faster, F to fly

wildlands-open-world-framework.description: A streaming open-world framework test: explore seven seeded landscapes on foot or in flight from a lake overlook, with a torch, world map and save export.
wildlands-open-world-framework.controls: WASD to move, mouse to look, F to switch walking and flight, Tab for map, L for torch

wyrm-and-wander.description: Lead three heroes across a pixel-art kingdom, seeking the Moon Sigil, sailing to the Hollow Tower and defeating the Crown Wyrm to recover the stolen tidebell.
wyrm-and-wander.controls: WASD or arrows to move, E to interact, I for items, K for magic, M for map

wyrm-and-wonder.description: Explore the village of Bellwether in a 3D storybook RPG, befriend a tiny leafy companion named Pip, fight command battles and face a very large dragon.
wyrm-and-wonder.controls: WASD to move, drag to look, E to act, M for map

wyrmward-v.description: Explore Bramblewick and Echo Hollow in a low-poly JRPG, recruiting a creature ally and fighting turn-based battles to bring a missing villager home.
wyrmward-v.controls: WASD or arrows to move, drag to turn the camera, Space to interact

zero-day.description: Solve hands-on computer puzzles across five eras from 1962 to 2025, inspecting 3D labs, reading notes, rewiring hardware and typing terminal commands.
zero-day.controls: Click highlighted objects, drag to orbit, type commands in the terminal
